verdict.rationale: Autumn has a dedicated webhooks page. It documents an event fired whenever a customer's plans change (new subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades) and names use cases such as triggering workflows and syncing with external systems, so the core of subscribing to events via webhooks is delivered. Missing for 10: a full event catalog beyond plan changes, details on endpoint registration, signature verification and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
